title: Co-area formula for C¹ maps on C¹ submanifolds (Simon 2.6.3, 2.6.6)
statement: Let k ≥ 1, n = m + k, M an n-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold of ℝᴺ, U ⊇ M open, f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ C¹ on U, and g : ℝᴺ → [0,∞] a.e.-measurable for Hⁿ restricted to M. With J*f = coareaJacobian M f = √det(L L*), L = Df|_{T_xM}: y ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{y}} g dHᵏ is Lebesgue-a.e.-measurable and ∫_M g J*f dHⁿ = ∫_{ℝᵐ} ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{y}} g dHᵏ dLᵐ(y) (Hᵈ = μHE[d]).
